Title: What happens with an equipment locations when a minion gets burned or diablerized?

Messages.Author: Claudio Falcao
Messages.Body:
William Thorbecke has equipped with The Ankara Citadel, Turkey.

William goes to torpor and gets eaten.

What happens with The Ankara Citadel, Turkey?

a) Stays in play uncontrolled
In this case, can it:
- be target of a (D) action? (eg Rampage)
- be stolen via Disputed Territory?

b) Gets burned together with the minion

Name: The Ankara Citadel, Turkey
[AH:U5, CE:U, KoT:U]
Cardtype: Equipment
Clan: Tremere
Cost: 2 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play.
The vampire with this location pays only half of the blood cost for
any cards he or she plays (round down).
Artist: Greg Simanson; Brian LeBlanc

Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:
